name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for the waiver of the immunity of Daniel Attard
part_text:
1. This report asks the European Parliament not to lift the legal protection (immunity) of Daniel Attard, a Member of the European Parliament from Malta. Belgian prosecutors want to charge him over attending a football match in a box paid for by Huawei, which they call bribery. Parliament's legal affairs committee found the request unclear and poorly evidenced, and said some claims rested on mistaken identity. The report proposes Parliament refuse the request, so the Belgian case cannot go ahead for now.

2.  
- Parliament would keep Attard's immunity, blocking the Belgian prosecution for now.
- It affects Attard and Belgian prosecutors handling the case.
- Parliament's President would send the decision to Belgium and to Attard.
